title: Activate the Guard V4 trusted-base workflow (03 section 6, V4-TODO-011 phase 1)
goal: Move Guard from G1_V4_DORMANT_BASE to G1_V4_WORKFLOW_ACTIVE: make the product activation-ready, record the genesis acceptance, install the base-owned V4 verdict workflow on main, prove it with negative and positive control pull requests, and update the backlog, leaving the ruleset (G2) to V4-TODO-011.
acceptanceCriteria: The specimen targets main, prefetches only base-locked NuGet dependencies with SHA-512 verification, and keeps check identities, trust direction and failure semantics unchanged.
Dormant-state checks accept .github/workflows/v4-guards.yml only when absent or byte-identical to the specimen except its first comment line.
The product refinement PR is certified Linux-complete and Windows-full at its exact head with one packageHash and merged by the operator.
A schema-valid, human-review genesis record binds the activated base, package, contracts manifest, certification reports and recovery point.
The active workflow is committed directly on main, and a negative-control PR fails v4-required while a positive-control PR passes it.
TODO V4-TODO-011, V4-TODO-008 and V4-TODO-012, the 03 Guard adaptation note and the migration records are updated by the positive-control PR; no ruleset, required context, tag or release is created.
risks: An active workflow could drift from the reviewed specimen or let a candidate supply its own judge.
Networked dependency prefetch could admit unlocked packages if it read candidate-controlled locks.
Advisory verdicts without a ruleset do not block merges until V4-TODO-011 phase 2.
decisions: Split activation: workflow now (phase 1), ruleset later under V4-TODO-011 (phase 2, G2).
Prefetch locked NuGet dependencies from the materialized base only and verify SHA-512; NuGet.config stays offline.
Workflow and genesis-record changes enter main only through operator-authorized direct commits, never candidate PRs.
Keep ci-contract targetBranch as a declared schema constant; the runner does not read it.
